item.title: Exploring the potential of aerial lidar: introduction to lidR
item.description:
1. Introduction & Acknowledgments

The workflow integrates: 1. Custom workflow script based on regional LiDAR data (e.g., Open Data Vlaanderen) pre-classified with deep learning models (3D SegFormer). 2. Individual Tree Segmentation (ITS) techniques adapted from the lidRtutorial by Tristan Goodbody (GitHub repository). 3. Advanced tree metrics and point cloud processing concepts inspired by Liam Irwin’s CompTreeR. The code was compiled and documented with the support of Gemini.

2. Setup & Data Preparation

2.1 Package Installation & Environment

First, ensure all required R packages are installed.
